# Folio 1.0-beta1

Folio 1.0-beta1 is available for Linux amd64. The release includes the Folio
server, static management panel, and a one-command installer.

## Install

On a Linux amd64 host with systemd:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Aoody743/Folio/releases/download/1.0-beta1/install-1.0-beta1.sh | sudo bash
```

The bootstrap downloads the package and `SHA256SUMS.txt`, checks the package
SHA-256, then runs the installer contained in the verified archive. The
installer source is [`scripts/rewrite/install-1.0-beta1.sh`](https://github.com/Aoody743/Folio/blob/1.0-beta1/scripts/rewrite/install-1.0-beta1.sh).

## Changes

- Adds Folio branding and a refreshed management panel.
- Hides deferred controls from the first-release navigation.
- Includes screenshots for all 18 visible panel pages.
- Keeps optional Agent capabilities disabled unless explicitly enabled.

The release assets include the Linux amd64 archive, the one-command installer,
and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
